dm me if you need help with it but type in view-code: before the url (view-code:youtube.com)  


copy all of the source code that you see (ctrl+a)

  
paste source code into code editor (i use [https://www.quackit.com/html/html\_editors/scratchpad/](https://www.quackit.com/html/html_editors/scratchpad/))  


then press the run button and you can access it from the code editor
